author: goddardgames
title: Looking for artist for card art designs
content: Just putting some feelers out. We are looking for an artist to help with some designs and/or some alt artwork for card art. I’d rather find someone from web3 than goto Fiverr. Only a few things needed. Nothing major. Feel free to DM!

author: AbstractEnt
title: Looking for 2D pixel artist for game backgrounds and sprites
content: LOOKING FOR A 2D PIXEL ARTIST! Hey everyone! I’m looking for a talented 2D pixel artist to help bring The Blood of Champions: A New Fighting Era to life! I’m specifically looking for someone who specializes in RPG-style roaming animations, walking sprites, and detailed pixel art backgrounds and environments to help expand the world of our game. I’m planning to commission someone in the next few weeks, so if you specialize in this kind of work, I’d love to check out your portfolio! I’m excited to connect with artists and find the right fit for the project. Interested? Drop your portfolio in the replies or send me a DM! Retweets are greatly appreciated to help spread the word. No spams I will not reply! Contact: DM or replies.
